Comment: NetPulse ingest pipeline. The deployable Amazon States Language definition matching src/pipeline/ingest-workflow.ts. Deployed by infra/terraform/modules/step-functions.

PrepareControllerList.Comment: The clouds THIS customer runs - Meraki, Mist, Aruba Central. Kept in the definition so onboarding a vendor is a Terraform change with an audit trail, not a code deploy. Per-tenant subsets live in DynamoDB; this is the default.

PollControllers.Comment: Fan out one Lambda per vendor. MaxConcurrency 4 keeps us inside every vendor rate limit. ToleratedFailurePercentage lets the run succeed on partial data - a dead controller feed must not block the ones still answering.

Retry.Comment: Vendor throttling and 5xx. Full jitter is applied inside the Lambda as well - Step Functions backoff alone still synchronises retries across parallel branches.

Catch.Comment: Never fail the whole run for one vendor.

NormaliseToObservations.Comment: Vendor payloads -> canonical Observation[]. Pure function; safe to retry.

EnrichAndDeduplicate.Comment: Resolve each observation to a site, and fold duplicates sharing a dedupeKey. Best-effort: a webhook can name a device the inventory has never seen, so failure continues rather than aborts. Site lookup is an in-memory join against inventory cached at module scope - a round trip per observation is neither fast nor cheap at this rate.

AnyObservations.Comment: A quiet polling window is a success, not a failure.

EvaluateRules.Comment: Per-device deterministic rules -> Alarm[], and fold the newest observation into hot state. No LLM here on purpose: what pages a human at 4am must be identical every time and explainable to the person it woke.

CorrelateIncidents.Comment: Corroborate and merge alarms into incidents. Two independent vendors before raising, and one road closure is one incident with fourteen devices rather than fourteen pages.

PersistAndPublish.Comment: BatchWriteItem to DynamoDB, then PutEvents to EventBridge. Write before publish, so a subscriber that immediately queries cannot 404. NOTE what is published: alarms and incidents only. Observations are persisted and folded into hot state but never reach the bus - an estate produces far more observations than decisions, so it would make bus cost scale with estate size instead of with incidents.

NotifyFailure.Comment: Terminal failure path. Publishes to EventBridge so alerting is a rule, not hard-wired here.

FailExecution.Cause: See the IngestFailed event and the execution history for detail.
